name: Droost Search
description: Semantic, lexical, and code-graph search over the Drupal codebase (custom, contrib, themes, optionally core/config), exposed to AI agents as MCP tools. Submodule of Droost.
project_description: Droost Search adds semantic, lexical (symbol) and code-graph search over the Drupal codebase and exposes it to AI agents as MCP tools. It discovers source (custom, contrib and theme code, optionally core and active config), chunks PHP/Twig/docs (PHP via nikic/php-parser, with symbol collection), embeds the chunks through a pluggable embedding backend (a local or OpenAI-compatible HTTP server, or — with the droost_ai submodule — the site's AI default provider), and stores vectors in a pluggable vector store (auto/MariaDB native vectors/a portable store). It also extracts a code graph (who calls what, who depends on what) from PHP and YAML. Three read-only MCP tools serve the result: droost_search (semantic + lexical), droost_symbol (find classes/functions by FQN substring) and droost_graph (edges for a symbol or a pseudo-symbol like service:<id>, route:<name>, hook:<name>). The index is built and refreshed with drush droost:search:index. It depends on the Droost base module. This documents the 1.0.0-rc1 pre-release.
